description: Check if a URL is up. Sends a HEAD request (GET fallback that reads at most 8 KB) to a public http(s) URL and returns the HTTP status code, ok true/false, final URL after redirects, content type, content length and response time in ms. A cheap uptime, health or broken-link check before a heavier fetch. Public hosts only; private, local and logged-in URLs are refused. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402 on Base) or 1 prepaid pack credit. Failed calls aren't charged when you pay per call with x402: if the job errors, the USDC payment is never settled. With pack credits (X-Entitlement-Key), a call that fails gives its credit back.

method.description: Prefer HEAD (default); GET peeks at most 8KB
